about: Delivery directions for Lock Fourteen's voices (eleven_v4 audio tags). 'default' is per speaker; 'say' is a line's full spoken text with tags, which must equal the page text once the tags are removed. Run from cozyverse/steeplewyke: STORY=../mystery3 python3 tools/directions.py <lines.json> writes ../mystery3/voices.json.

say.end-full-4: [quiet, steady] I put the reserve into the Meridian fund on Ted Hollins's advice, and when it closed I told the committee nothing, because I thought I could put it right before anyone needed the money.
say.end-full-5: [very quiet] When he fell I could hear him, and I went to the car for my windlass, and I wound the paddles up; when it was full I wound them down and put the chain back on, because that is what you do at night.
say.end-full-7: [long pause] [almost a whisper] Neville was right about the gates.
say.p2-kit-12: [quietly] I gave him that at twenty to eight. I had a train.
say.p2-kit-15: [urgent, low] Don't tell Clive. Please. If they know I'm going they'll end the post before I've got the other one.
say.p4-annette-6: [cold, controlled] The undertaker rang. He says there's to be another post-mortem, and the funeral can't be Wednesday. Nobody from your office rang me.
say.p9-clive-16: [short pause] [quiet] The chairman was very thorough.
say.p3-joost-9: [reluctant] Yes. At fourteen also. He stood there and told us how to do it. Then he took my windlass, to show me. I took it back from him, and it fell on the stones. In the dark I could not find it.
